caption:
Hey Cine Chaska family! Weekend aa gaya hai aur hum lekar aaye hain aapke liye 5 dumdaar recommendations. Ranbir Kapoor ki Ramayana se lekar Tamannaah ki Bandra tak, sab kuch hai list mein. Horror ke shaukeen Carrie aur Godzilla ka anand le sakte hain. Baa Baa Black Sheep bhi hai aapke weekend ko mazedaar banane ke liye. Toh taiyaar ho jao popcorn aur cold drink lekar! 🔥🍿

Inmein se kaunsi film aap pehle dekhoge? Comment mein batao! 👇
